Block Studio views

The Block's Studio is where you think: one card per sNN, its groups as view buttons. Four choices; each option shows the page, an orange box marks what differs. My pick is selected; change any, then Copy feedback and paste it to me. The questions as Markdown: question_collection.md.

Q1Studio views

Studio's view buttons are its groups, read from each face's Tags:. Today there are six, and s04 shows in both Interface and Navigation. This is s53's open question: one UI group, or one per level?

Which group buttons does the Block's Studio show?

Why A: Grouped by type, as you chose for the Report; s04 shows once.

Q2View sections

A group holds topics from the Block and from each Task below it: UI holds s04 at the Block and s51 to s59 at j03's three Tasks. Today they are one list.

What splits one group's view into sections?

Why A: Each heading names the folder those topics sit in, so you know where to work.

Q3Card line

A card shows one line under its name. Today it is the Topic's first sentence, cut at its first semicolon; the open question sits only on the face.

Which line does a Studio card show?

Why A: Studio is for thinking: each card says what is still open.

Q4Waiting flag

Today a waiting form shows only on its card's Interaction button, inside its group's view. You open each group to find it.

Where else does a waiting form show?

Why A: What waits on you is orange and first, as on every other row.
